programme.title: 煙囪小鎮的普佩
programme.desc: 故事講述在煙霧瀰漫的煙囪小鎮另一頭，竟有著星星的存在一年前，藉由連環話劇講述星星故事的布魯諾突然人間蒸發，布魯諾的兒子．魯必奇為了維持家計而休學，並當起煙囪清潔工魯必奇一直堅信著父親口中的星星，卻被居民們視為騙子而孤立起來在萬聖節的夜裡，奇蹟發生了！

programme.title: 唐伯虎點秋香
programme.desc: 周星馳與鞏俐合演的顛覆喜劇，講述富貴而擁有多位嬌妻的詩人唐伯虎，見到太師府的名婢秋香，化為下人進入府中追求佳人，在幾經波折後化解世仇太夫人的怨恨，與重重考驗後抱得美人歸

programme.title: 臨時劫案
programme.desc: 生活拮据的摔角手梅藍天決定鋌而走險，計畫越洋來港策動一宗閃電械劫，而廢柴級的計程車司機阿慫和同樣廢柴的老人院社工慕容輝也動了搶劫發財的念頭，三人誤打誤撞臨時組隊搶劫，為了追蹤一筆搶來的巨款，捲入一場風波，更惹來精明女幹探的追捕

programme.title: 肥龍過江
programme.desc: 一名警察和前警探及餐廳老闆娘聯手偵查一樁離奇的謀殺案，卻馬上得罪了東京當地的一票黑幫

programme.title: 天坑
programme.desc: 搬到首爾生活的東元，實現擁有自己的家的夢想但從搬到新家第一天開始，就槓上了愛管閒事的住戶萬壽東元為了紀念有了自己的房子，邀請同事們來新家慶祝就在大家沉浸於幸福的美夢時，整棟建築竟突然掉進超大型天坑中！只要一見面就會吵架的萬壽和東元拜訪東元新家的金代理和實習生恩珠，掉到地下500公尺滲穴中的他們，最後能平安無事地脫困嗎？

programme.title: 航海王:1093
programme.desc: 偉大航路的黃金梅利號阿拉巴斯坦的王女．薇薇也在船上被稱為沙漠之國的阿拉巴斯坦王國，從以前就一直被不降雨的異常氣像所困擾，為人民著想的國王．寇布拉身邊，人人和平的生活著但是距今兩年前，雨變得只落在國王所居住的城市裡，同時間，世界政府禁止製造持有的人工降雨粉．跳舞粉也運往國王的身邊這事件成為國王與人民分裂的開端相信身為父親也是國王．寇布拉的薇薇，為了要把引起這異常氣像並陷害國王的邪惡組織的身分曝光而離開她的國家而現在為了阻止萬惡根源卻是國家英雄的克洛克達爾，薇薇和魯夫等夥伴一同前往阿拉巴斯坦為了奪回被奪走的重要東西而奔走！

programme.desc: 劇情描述邱澤飾演的討債流氓，看似兇狠實際上卻有顆柔軟的心，他在一次討債過程中對債主女兒許瑋甯一見鐘情，進而提出要用塗鴉合約，以吃飯散步的方式來抵銷她們家的債務，這種吊兒啷噹的態度，簡直顛覆了許瑋甯的世界，兩人完全不對盤的個性，究竟會擦出怎麼樣的火花？

programme.desc: 朱秀才連考十多次也未中狀元，老父因此氣得病逝，老婆也離他而去，無奈之下朱在一座廟裡懸樑自盡，不料心中有冤屈，無法投胎轉世，靈魂只有附在自盡那條麻繩上 八十年代，高中學生林青青林小花及顏如玉在假期旅行中為避暴風雨，誤闖進古廟，青在忙亂中將麻繩帶回宿舍，靈魂附在麻繩上的朱也跟被帶進學校，鬧出不少笑話朱與她們成了好朋友，並規勸她們要靠自己的能力去創造未來，而朱亦因此沉冤得雪，投胎轉世

programme.title: 長歌行:11
programme.desc: 原是永寧郡主的李長歌因玄武門之變父喪母亡，她僥倖逃出城，赴幽州求援；途中，偶遇化名秦准的草原部落特勤阿詩勒隼，兩人不打不相識，漸生英雄相惜之感長歌在幽州粉碎一場陰謀，但郡主的身份卻敗露，前往?州避禍長歌藏於?州太守公孫恆身邊，助其共抗草原勢力侵襲，卻未想到敵方將領阿詩勒隼竟是自己的舊識秦准

programme.title: 陪你很久很久
programme.desc: 憨直的九餅從小就暗戀著青梅竹馬薄荷，兩人一路相互陪伴，卻始終維持著好朋友的關係誰料一上大學，九餅意外地與甜美高中生夏天成為同房室友，又在迎新試膽大會時，不小心將薄荷推向校園天菜麥子學長懷中，眼看著心愛的她即將被追走，九餅究竟要如何守住薄荷，為自己的青春奮力一搏！

programme.title: 黑道診所
programme.desc: 位於市中心邊緣的黑道診所是前白龍幫退休老大左白龍所開設的，所有黑道幫派有個不成文的規定，所有受傷的道上兄弟都送到黑道診所裡診所裡迷糊的小護士小艾總是笨手笨腳，明明快好的傷口都已經結痂了，卻在換藥時太過大力撕開而血流不止原本在槍林彈雨中出生入死的黑道兄弟們，直到住院這幾天才知道什麼叫做害怕！每當聽到小艾在門口喊著換藥囉！黑道兄弟們便開始手心冒汗嘴唇發白

programme.title: 奇謀妙計五福星
programme.desc: 茶壺死氣喉凡士林鬈毛積及劉克司五人出獄後決定改邪歸正，與鬈毛積的妹妹（妹頭）同組五寶清潔公司某次匪徒正交易偽鈔電版時遇上劫匪，剛巧被 CID 看見便一路追趕，後劫匪情急下將電版拋進五福星之清潔車中五寶開始被兩大反派追殺，最後五福星施展奇謀妙計應付兩大反派

programme.title: 鍾馗誅妖傳
programme.desc: 唐朝時期妖怪肆虐，天神因而封印妖王沐風的妖力，使其無法作亂妖王的伴侶，千年花妖風四娘，為了解除封印，便到處尋找捉妖天師鍾馗的下落面對強妖來襲，鍾馗為了保護百姓，想出一招險記來對付風四娘

programme.title: 逆轉勝
programme.desc: 小香（黃姵嘉飾）是明星高中品學兼優的好學生，也是學校的儀隊隊長，青春無敵堅強不服輸但在父母相繼過世後，可觀的債務讓家裡經營的撞球館面臨倒閉命運不但引來社會局上門關切，強制介入安排寄養家庭，更有黑道討債集團威脅逼迫還款腹背受敵走投無路的小香只好與好友黑輪（劉以豪飾）商量，費盡千辛萬苦，找到十年前的一代撞球球王，卻因欠債跑路，至此人間蒸發的叔叔雙丰（溫尚翊飾）回來擔任監護人

programme.title: 小孩不笨2
programme.desc: 片中以家長管教子女時所面對的困難為主題，真實反映青少年在學校及家庭裡所需面對的壓力透過TOMJERRY及成才的故事，讓觀眾能體會到孩子們不只是需要父母親的關愛，他們更需要父母親給予他們的賞識及肯定此片是一部笑中有淚充滿教育性質的輕鬆喜劇，絕對適合全家大小一同觀賞，更能讓現代父母了解，天底下沒有教不會的小孩，只有不會教的父母

programme.title: 碧血劍:5
programme.desc: 夏雪宜?綽號金蛇郎君，全家被溫家堡之惡人慘殺，誓要報仇遇上溫儀後被儀的純真與善良打動，結成愛侶可惜溫儀被溫家堡利用，令雪宜身中劇毒及被挑斷手筋腳筋，儀欲將溫家惡行公開而遭活埋井下亡在生死關頭，雪宜被何紅藥救走並逼婚，結果被打斷雙腳，秘密囚於五毒教的靈蛇洞內 袁承誌?袁崇煥之子，立誌長大後保衛國家父被曹化淳誣害慘死，並誅連九族，承誌被夏雪宜所救，隨後在華山學藝，誓報父仇

programme.title: 狄仁傑之四大天王
programme.desc: 狄仁傑（趙又廷飾）大破神都龍王案，獲御賜亢龍?，並掌管大理寺，使他成為武則天（劉嘉玲飾）走向權力之路最大的威脅武則天為了消滅眼中釘，命令尉遲真金（馮紹峰飾）集結實力強勁的異人組，妄圖奪取亢龍?神都洛陽接連發生奇案，頭戴蚩尤鬼面的武士團四處行兇；酒館外的狐狸通曉人語；紫微宮儀鸞殿柱子上的雕龍活了過來在醫官沙陀忠（林更新飾）的協助下，狄仁傑既要守護亢龍?，又要破獲神秘奇案，還要面對武則天的步步緊逼，大唐江山陷入了空前的危機之中

programme.title: 翻供
programme.desc: 獲得百想藝術大獎最佳新人男演員 入圍青龍電影獎最佳女配角 從小因父親重男輕女，貞仁（申惠善 飾演）在中學時就逃家自力更生，與家人斷了聯繫貞仁後來憑一己之力成為頂級辯護律師，在一次偶然中，她得知罹患失智症的母親花子（裴宗玉 飾演）涉嫌殺害父親，同時還對不少無辜民眾下毒手 懷疑事有蹊翹的貞仁決定親自出馬，在層層阻撓下，她該如何為母親翻供，揭開這個樁謀殺案背後不可告人的真相？

programme.title: 幼齒老婆
programme.desc: 在加拿大進修的風流大學生尚民，某天突然接到父母通知，要他回國和情竇初開的16歲高一小女生寶恩結婚！原來，兩人的祖父曾約定讓各自的孫子成婚，然而眼見小倆口都抗拒這樁姻緣，寶恩的祖父只好假裝即將離世以促成婚事而不能曝光的秘密夫妻關係，隨著尚民去寶恩就讀的高中實習而危機四伏

programme.title: 小孩不笨3
programme.desc: 小孩不笨3故事描述升學大敵當前，媽媽文婷（胡靜 飾）展開各式包贏攻略，逼著兒子梓豪（周俞辰 飾）念書，所有魔鬼補習方法接踵而來，完全不理會孩子是否承受得了梓豪靠著死背活背讓成績明顯進步，引起校內一直以來的學霸Jayden（江松恆 飾）的媽媽Sophia（柳勝美 飾）的注意，深怕兒子坐不上第一名的寶座

programme.title: 大釣哥
programme.desc: 大釣哥的兒子不叫小釣哥，叫藍小龍藍正龍 飾手腳敏捷攀岩走壁，跟著老爸專偷扒手偷來的竊物救濟貧戶，希望引出老爸的世敵黑熊吳朋奉 飾演 不料，為了幫助法律系畢業的心儀對象黃心怡謝沛恩 飾赴美深造，小龍竟向黑熊借了兩百萬！在某次火拼時，為黑熊頂罪，以現行犯被收押大釣哥為了幫兒子洗清罪嫌，請求舊識同時是檢察官吳克群 飾的母親白秀娟楊貴媚 飾聯手追查真相時，扯出案外案，逆轉全局戲碼，即將爆笑爆淚登場

programme.title: 劇場版派遣女醫 X Final
programme.desc: 當今的日本，白色巨塔已然崩壞，本該是拯救生命的醫療體制，也被迫迎來弱肉強食的時代在陷入危機的日本醫療現場，一群獨來獨往的自由醫生出現了，他們就像獨行俠般，不受體制牽絆，一如這位美麗性感的天才外科醫生大門未知子（米倉涼子飾演），她討厭成群結黨討厭權威討厭束縛，專業醫師執照與扎實養成的醫術，是她的唯一武器 這回，大門為了拯救某國總統的生命而離開日本...

programme.title: 封神第一部-朝歌風雲
programme.desc: 商王殷壽（費翔 飾）與嬌豔的狐妖妲己（娜然 飾）交好，暴虐無道，將引發天譴，崑崙仙人姜子牙（黃渤 飾）遂攜封神榜下山，尋找天下共主以救蒼生曾視殷壽為明主的太子殷郊（陳牧馳 飾）以及西伯侯質子姬發（于適 飾）也漸漸發現殷壽的狠毒面目，決定反出朝歌各方勢力暗流湧動，朝歌即將風雲變色

programme.title: 總舖師
programme.desc: 楊祐寧夏于喬林美秀吳念真柯一正聯合演出 20多年前，台灣辦桌界有三大傳奇總舖師稱霸北中南！分別為憨人師吳念真飾鬼頭師喜翔飾與蒼蠅師柯一正飾，鄉民們尊稱他們人鬼神三霸隨著時代變動，辦桌文化勢微，人鬼神凋零蒼蠅師想將家傳手藝交給獨生女詹小婉夏于喬飾，誰知小婉只想當明星，美美出現在螢光幕前但一心逃離油煙血水的小婉卻被迫面對巨大的挑戰和使命..... 原來想當明星的小婉的星途走的並不順遂，再加上遇上一個惡意留下債務給她揹的男友，於是只好跑路回家鄉；豈料自己的母親過的也不好，因為自蒼蠅師過世後，其弟子阿財師便接收所有的生意，而小婉母親的廚藝又不好，更是惹出麻煩，最後也落入跑路一途母女兩人便相依為命地開了一間小麵館，雖然生意因故而時好時壞，總是可以維持生計 有一天，一位來歷神秘的客人因故決定教小婉幾道辦桌的菜餚...

programme.title: 龍馬精神
programme.desc: 昔日風光的龍虎武師老羅一夜變調，現今的他窮困潦倒，與他的愛馬赤兔在片場靠著跑龍套過日子老羅一心想將赤兔培養成動作巨星，然而天外飛來橫禍，老羅與赤兔無端身陷官司，只能求助多年未見的女兒小寶和她的律師男友乃華與此同時，老羅與討債集團的追逐戰影片在網路瘋傳，讓他獲得了拍電影的機會

programme.title: 黑獄斷腸歌之砌生豬肉
programme.desc: 六十年代的香港警界貪汙成風，導致黑獄重重，正報記者程安（梁朝偉 飾）撰文揭露警界黑幕，被探長張耀祖（吳毅將 飾）視為眼中釘張耀祖陷害程安藏毒，使其入獄，更將程的女友小慈（張文慈 飾）玷汙程安在獄中作為幫派人士之外的羊，雖有羊頭飛機木（吳孟達 飾）看顧，也受盡大佬們侮辱

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.desc: Once a top student, housewife Lin Shuang is forced to fight for the custody of her daughter in light of her husbands betrayal. She returns to the workforce and cross paths with her ex-classmate. (曾经是顶级学生,家庭主妇林舒安被迫为她的女儿的监护而战.)

programme.title: Call Me By Fire 2026 Ep05 (以2026年Ep05号火力呼叫我)
programme.desc: Brothers from diverse fields face live vocal performances and outdoor challenges. Through survival trials and fierce competition, they push their limits and ignite their passion in pursuit of glory. (来自不同领域的兄弟面临现场现场表演和户外挑战。 通过生存试验和激烈竞争,他们推推推极限,点燃追求荣耀的激情。)

programme.title: The Story Of Eyes Ep04 (《眼睛的故事》Ep04)
programme.desc: This documentary focuses on awareness about eye health, eye diseases that have been conquered, irreversible blinding eye diseases, and myopia prevention control. (这部纪录片重点关注人们对眼睛健康的认识,已被征服的眼睛疾病,不可逆转的盲目眼睛疾病和近视预防控制.)

programme.title: The First Jasmine Ep37 ((莫离 Ep37))
programme.desc: Starring leading stars Bai Lu and Cheng Lei, a revenge-driven noblewoman and her enigmatic prince husband unite against a cunning rival, their alliance slowly turning into something deeper. (带着主角的明星 Bai Lu 和 Cheng Lei, 一位仇恨的贵族女和她的神秘的王子丈夫,)

programme.title: Journey To The Snack West Ep04 (前往草纸西Ep04)
programme.desc: Spanning six episodes of culinary adventure, this series adopts the narrative framework of Journey to the West to showcase the most raw and authentic folk culinary traditions along the Silk Road. (这系列的六集事,采用了"旅程到西方"的叙事框架,以展示丝之路沿线最原始和最真实的民间事传统.)

programme.desc: Upgrading to a team treasure hunt, each episode features different teams settling in a charming, cloud-shrouded village for a three-day, two-night immersive mountain treasure hunt. (每集都有不同的团队 在一个充满魅力的 云雾的村庄里 进行为期三天的 两周的 沉浸式山地寻宝)

programme.desc: The court intrigues, politicking, bickering and backstabbing continues in this sequel to The Empress Dowager. Starring Lisa Lu. (在"女皇"的续集中, 庭院的阴谋,政治,争和背中刺伤继续下去.)

programme.title: Come Drink With Me ((大醉侠))
programme.desc: King Hus groundbreaking film set the foundation for all his action films that followed, most notably Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon. (王斯的突破性电影为其后来的所有动作电影奠定了基础,最著名的是虎隐藏龙.)

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost ((鬼屋丽人))
programme.desc: A cruel uncle stands in the way between a young scholar and the beautiful gal with whom he falls in love, and happiness. (一位残忍的叔叔站在一个年轻的学者和他爱上的美丽女孩之间,)

programme.title: The Master of Kung Fu ((南拳蔡李佛))
programme.desc: In this action-packed experimental piece, an all-too-human Huang Fei-hung battles a gangsters plan to frame him for robbery and murder. (在这个充满动作的实验作品中,一个太过人性的人,黄飞与一个帮派谋杀案的计划作战.)

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess ((万花迎春))
programme.desc: One of the most enjoyable musicals to grace the Hong Kong screen, this classic stars the husband-and-wife team of Peter Chen and Betty Loh. (香港电影中最有趣的音乐剧之一, 这部经典剧中,)

programme.title: Raw Courage ((虎胆))
programme.desc: First a hero and then his daughter try to protect Ming Emperor Jianwen infant son from rebels headed by Tien Fung. (首先是英雄,然后是他的女儿试图保护明皇帝文的婴儿儿子)

programme.title: Family Light Affair ((城市之光))
programme.desc: Serio-comic clashes of cultures ensue when a Mainland Chinese family try to make a go of it in Hong Kong. (华裔家庭在香港试图去做这件事.)

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin ((少林与武当))
programme.desc: Two rebel Shaolin warriors embark on a deadly secret mission aimed at bringing down the Ching Dynasty. Starring Lo Meng, Chin Siu Ho. (两名叛军沙龙战士开始了致命的秘密任务,旨在推翻清朝.)

programme.title: The Crimson Palm ((血手印))
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaws Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaires daughter. (演出中包括"乡村路"的难忘歌曲, 莎斯·黄梅歌剧主演艾维·林波,)

programme.title: Oversteer
programme.desc: Feng defies his father and leaves home to pursue his dream of becoming an auto mechanic. Along the way, he unexpectedly finds himself drawn into the thrilling world of car racing.

programme.title: Smashing Frank ((捣破法兰克))
programme.desc: After a jewelry store heist, the young thieves left behind a graffiti tag that reads FRANK, sparking public curiosity about their motives. What message are they trying to convey? (那些年轻的盗窃者在珠宝商店抢劫后,留下了一个写 FRANK 的涂标签,引起了人们对他们的动机的好奇.)

programme.title: Ready or Knot ((不日成婚))
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the next step.? (一对夫妇在婚礼上第一次见面,已经在一起五年,从不同的角度来看,他们质疑婚姻的立场.)

programme.title: Triad ((三生花))
programme.desc: Set in the 90s during the Hong Kong handover, this drama depicts how a bookworm rises to become a formidable leader in the triads. (这部剧描述一头书呆虫如何升起成为三合会的强大领袖。)

programme.title: Its a Wonderful Life ((好运到))
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his sons failed marriage and Kwais dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto. (泰,一个富人不满意他的儿子失败的婚姻,克瓦伊梦想成为漫画家.他希望他的女儿,安,但她从法国返回与野蛮的鲁伯托.)

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident ((生きてみたいもう一度 新宿バス放火事件))
programme.desc: A simple Chinese immigrant wages a perilous war against one of the most powerful criminal organizations on the planet, in this sprawling action drama (一场简单的中国移民工资 一场针对这个世界上最强大的犯罪组织之一的 危险的战争 在这场无休无止的行动中)

programme.title: YOLO ((乐活姐妹：怪诞冒险))
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey. (经过多年的自我忽视,决定重新接受生活.遇到拳击教练,她渴望重新开始.)

programme.title: In Broad Daylight ((盲人杀妻记))
programme.desc: Based on a true event of a news investigative unit receiving a tip-off about abuse in a care home for elderly and disabled. Reporter Kay goes undercover to unveil the cruel truth in broad daylight. (根据一个新闻调查部门在老人和残疾人养老院遭受虐待的真实事件,)

programme.title: Back To The Past ((寻秦记))
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lived in seclusion for 20 years until a time traveller returned to rewrite history, forcing them to defend the Qin dynasty and fate itself. (在帮助英正团结中国之后,洪小龙在隔离中生活了20年,直到旅行者返回重写历史,迫使他们保卫秦朝和命运。)

programme.title: Vital Signs ((生死征兆))
programme.desc: Paramedic Wang partners with Ma after being assigned to a new station. Though he clashes with Mas unconventional methods, Wang soon rediscovers the true mission of a paramedic - saving every life. (医护人员王在被派往新站后与马合作.虽然他与马的不传统方法发生冲突,但王很快重新发现了医护人员的真正使命 - - 拯救每一个生命.)

programme.title: Cold War ((冷战风云录))
programme.desc: Winner of 9 awards at the 32nd Hong Kong Film Awards! When a police van is hijacked, Deputy Commissioner M.B Lee launches a rescue operation codenamed Cold War. (获第32届香港电影奖9项奖项的获奖者!)

programme.title: Home Sweet Home ((情归阿拉巴马))
programme.desc: When a school bus driver is injured after risking his life to save a boy during an accident, the boys father invites him to live with them. However, disturbing facts soon begin to emerge. (当一名学校公交车司机在事故中冒着生命危险拯救一个男孩后受伤时,男孩的父亲邀请他和他们住在一起.)

programme.title: Last Song For You ((久别·重逢))
programme.desc: Musician Su reunites with his first love Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journeyher parting gift to reignite his life. (音乐家苏在医院里与他的第一爱情小姐相聚,在最黑暗的时刻.看到他的内心斗争,病的小姐把Su送到最后的旅程,她的分手礼物重新启发他的生活.)

programme.title: Moscow Mission ((警察学校7：进军莫斯科))
programme.desc: A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman takes charge of an operation to arrest the criminals who perform a heist on the train, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead... (一名中国警察伪装成一个商人,负责逮捕在火车上抢劫的罪犯的行动,)

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places ((最佳拍档之醉街拍档))
programme.desc: When the reluctant son of a gangster is summoned home to avenge his fathers death, he enlists his fathers always-drunk bodyguard to help him out. (当一个反抗的帮派的儿子被召回家报复父亲的死亡时,他招募了父亲的身保卫,)

programme.title: To Live And Die in Mongkok ((旺角監獄))
programme.desc: Disoriented and trapped in notorious, vice-ridden Mongkok, a once-feared triad figure struggles to adapt to life in the wake of his 30-year prison sentence. (一个曾经被恐惧的三元派人物,在被囚禁的臭名昭著的蒙古克里,)

programme.title: The Italian Recipe ((遇见你之后))
programme.desc: Celebrity Peng travels to Rome for the shooting of a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Man Man, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. (著名人前往罗马拍摄一部现实节目,遇到了一个普通女孩,)

programme.title: No information available ((特德·姜：))
programme.desc: No information available (没有信息)

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man ((百变星君))
programme.desc: After being discovered flirting with his boss daughter, Sing gets blown up, but later gets relived as his professor transforms him to be a cyborg of household products. (发现他和老板的女儿调情后,辛被炸毁,)

programme.title: We are Family (我们是家庭)
programme.desc: Rent-a-Family offers relatives for rent and in the process, the trio rendering such services discover the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way. (租一家人提供租的亲属, 在此过程中, 提供这些服务的三人发现了家庭关系的复杂性,)

programme.title: The Medallion ((飞龙再生))
programme.desc: Chan plays Eddie Yang, a Hong Kong cop who is working with Interpol officer Arthur Watson in order to protect a gifted young child. (Chan Eddie Yang是香港警察 与国际刑警组织官员Arthur Watson合作 保护一个有天赋的孩子)

programme.title: Peg O My Heart ((赎梦))
programme.desc: Haunted by nightmares, night-shift taxi driver Choi meets psychiatrist Dr. Man. In therapy, Man begins to experience disturbing and perplexing dreams, blurring the line between reality and illusion. (经过梦,夜班出租车司机乔遇到了精神科医生曼. 在治疗中,曼开始经历令人不安和困惑的梦想,)

programme.title: Cold War 2 ((寒战2))
programme.desc: Sean Lau, appointed as the Commissioner of Police after the success of the Cold War rescue operation, finds his reign rocked by the abduction of this wife and daughter. (Sean Lau在冷战救援行动成功后被任命为警察局长,他发现他的统治因妻子和女儿被绑架而震撼。)

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life ((浅浅岁月))
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once. (萨布里纳对安德鲁的深厚爱情被他的情侣关系所破坏,这结束了他们的婚姻.多年后,她回到照顾他,因为他被诊断患有癌症,相信真正的爱只有一次.)

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the mens help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Baos chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors...

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber 1977
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his fathers martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hungs passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lus disciple.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husbands death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bills nieces!

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman Golden Swallow is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar Drunken Cat who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kongs entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wongs disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as City Lights, is the directorwriters warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiance, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: Its an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wifes rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. Its one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Final Justice 1988
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob bosss collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the citys patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Ministers daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxis concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsus funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Maybe Its Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchants mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Rileys mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror her father is peeping at night and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kongs Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Lis daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior - USA vs. World: Part 2
programme.desc: The top Ninja Warrior athletes from Europe, Japan, and USA team up to see who can go the fastest or furthest on the ANW7 Las Vegas Finals course. Its Team Europe vs. Team Japan vs. Team USA.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Saul Canelo Alvarez vs. Jose Miguel Cotto
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Saul Canelo Alvarez defending his NABF welterweight title against Jose Miguel Cotto, Alvarezs final bout before rising through the ranks and championships of the WBC. Also on the card, a heavyweight kickboxing clash between Errol Zimmerman vs. Rico Verhoeven.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo - Tokyo, Japan Episode 3
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 3 from Tokyo, Japan at the Ryogoku Kokugikan, features Takayasu, Terunofuji, Meisei and Takakeisho.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights Floyd Mayweather Jr vs. Oscar De La Hoya
programme.desc: This episode features the WBC World super welterweight title between Floyd Mayweather, Jr. and Oscar De La Hoya that made 165 million in total gross revenue, making it the richest fight ever, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts - Mens Forms Championship

夏日奇妙书 My Marvellous Fable
programme.desc: 实习编辑冯天蓝加入出版社的第一份任务就是去催畅销作家王葡萄的稿件，而她交稿的条件就是让冯天蓝从北京开车送她回老家琼海！在回乡的旅程中，王葡萄开始说一些真假参杂的故事，冯天蓝在整理书稿中拼凑出了王葡萄的人生，而王葡萄也在创作中反思自我两个心中有伤的人展开了互相治愈的浪漫奇幻之旅.

programme.title: 爱情有烟火 Love Has Fireworks
programme.desc: Qian Fei hesitates to ask Fang Yun for another chance but prepares a serious research report. Li Yifei begins quietly caring for her, while Yao Jingjing mistakes Lu Zes proposal ring for betrayal.

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: 新型毒品粉精灵在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组三人分别擅长推理武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力故事融合卧底动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动As a new drug Pink Spirit spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 过街英雄 Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: 第三集n亮星刻意灌醉凯甄，欲拍下其意图醉驾的罪证，惜事败凯甄获得广福的信任后，计划借千手观音像骗取巨款，再转赠孟婆等无辜小业主凯甄在众人配合下成功令广福堕入骗局，带同巨款离开时，始知下属赵机智秦开心被抓住凯甄赴约跟杨氏兄弟交换人质及现金，惟寡不敌众被擒，埋伏一旁的亮星竟见死不救凯甄机智与开心惨遭活埋，此时亮星寻至凯甄意外看到母亲明雪梅的验身报告，为免刺激她，只好暂时隐瞒转当私家侦探的事.

programme.title: 过街英雄 Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: 第四集n雪梅到工作室找卓淇，却见凯甄身处隔壁的侦探社，感疑惑，亮星应卓淇所求替凯甄解围，及后以此威胁凯甄删除片段美芬为索分手费，与丽芸合计欺骗男友，餐厅老板隋俊伟看在眼里为调查校园欺凌事件，凯甄亮星分别以戏剧老师和校工身分混入学校美芬在街上兜售新楼盘，被同行逼出马路，刚巧邂逅俊伟美芬查到俊伟背景，誓要钓到这位金龟婿凯甄怀疑欺凌案与家长张嘉莉有关，命亮星色诱她，此时亮星忽闻学生呼救声.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: 食为奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.title: 爱情食物链 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾.

programme.title: 廉政行動2022 ICAC Investigators 2022
programme.desc: 十年前，唐偉聰袁偉豪飾與沈傲鳴譚俊彥飾同期加入廉署，兩人一起受訓，情同兄弟傲鳴因一次私自行動而受傷，未幾辭職，從此杳無音訊十年後，偉聰已晉升為總調查主任，並率領李進兒蔡思貝飾細粒陳曉華飾等下屬致力維護廉潔與公義偉聰於調查一宗懷疑銀行職員貪污案件時，發現傲鳴竟牽涉其中原來傲鳴憑其過往在廉署的調查經驗，助犯案集團多次避過各地刑事與反貪機構的偵查偉聰痛心好友忘記當年加入廉署捍衛公平公義的初心，誓要將犯案集團繩之於法！.

programme.title: 赤沙印记 四叶草.2 Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: 沙滩上，少年十五二十时；他们抛汗， 他们随入情网叶菁杨婉仪叶蕙李思欣及叶茵陈自琦三姊妹小时侯 碰到一个古上贼女郎部容衢儿，女郎预言大家姐将在十八岁那年，遇见身上有四叶草胎记的真命天子转眼间三姊妹已长大，现在是清岚国际学校的中六生清岚沙滩排球队的队长干逸臣司徒瑞祈外表俊朗性格活泼，是校内的风头人物，很多女同学也为了他而加入沙滩排球队，犹如行星屋绕太阳一般一日，三姊妹分别在不同的角度看见臣身上有一个近似四叶草形状的胎记，跟小时侯听到的预言吻合，但菁为人优柔寡断没有主见，菁与茵因因此抛身而出，为制造机会给姐姐而不断奔走不久，三姊妹亦加入了沙滩排球队她们觉得的是，她们竟又在校内的垒学士方上发现四叶草胎记！三姊妹顿感迷闷，不知道吉卜赛女郎所言的真命天子究竟是谁.

Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain Haji Zul Ariffin, ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian Nur Fazura, ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra Farid Kamil, yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie Izara Aishah dan Jiman Iedil Putra, Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP5
programme.desc: Farhan bercadang untuk pulang dan bekerja di kampung, bapanya tidak bersetuju. Pada satu malam, Aishah mengigau berjalan masuk ke dalam rumah Wan Peah. Siti meminta bantuan 3 sahabat karibnya membawa Aishah balik ke rumah. Li berkejar ke rumah Tok Hashim meminta pertolongan. Sesampai Tok Hashim ke rumah Wan Peah, Siti berjaya mengeluarkan anaknya, Tok Hashim terus mencari Wan Peah. Tiba-tiba muncul Wan Peah di hadapannya. Tok Hashim melarikan diri sambil meracau-racau.

programme.title: The Equalizer S1 EP1
programme.desc: Seorang bekas ejen CIA yang misteri dan menggunakan kemahirannya yang luas untuk membantu mereka yang tidak mempunyai tempat lain untuk meminta pertolongan. Ketika McCall menyesuaikan diri dengan kehidupan sebagai orang awam, dia terdorong untuk menggunakan sumber yang dimilikinya bagi membantu Jewel Lorna Courtney, seorang remaja yang dituduh membunuh dan sedang diburu oleh penjenayah yang telah memerangkapnya atas jenayah tersebut

programme.title: Coklat
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Mira membesarkan anaknya Maya setelah kematian suaminya. Mira belajar membuat coklat dan mata pencariannya adalah mengambil tempahan coklat. Yamin pula guru yang membesarkan anaknya Iyad seorang diri. Iyad selalu membuat hal samada di sekolah atau dengan jiran-jiran di rumah. Coklat buatan Mira popular dalam kalangan kanak-kanak di kawasan mereka. Maya dan Iyad berkawan baik. Walaupun selalu bergaduh tapi mereka rapat. Maya selalu pertahankan Iyad apabila Iyad dibuli oleh Castello. Dalila pula agak kesunyian bila baru pindah di taman perumahan itu. Namun Maya dan Iyad selalu menemani Dalila sehingga mereka menjadi kawan baik.

programme.title: Blondie In An Ancient Time
programme.desc: Blondie in Ancient Time mengisahkan seorang gadis berambut perang bernama Blondie yang secara misteri terperangkap di zaman purba akibat kejadian luar biasa. Terasing di dunia yang asing dengan adat, bahasa, dan kuasa politik yang kejam, Blondie terpaksa menyesuaikan diri demi kelangsungan hidup. Dengan kebijaksanaan, keberanian, dan hati yang tulus, dia perlahan-lahan memenangi kepercayaan penduduk tempatan serta menarik perhatian seorang pahlawan bangsawan yang berjiwa mulia. Namun, di sebalik percintaan yang berputik, Blondie terjebak dalam konflik istana, pengkhianatan, dan perebutan kuasa yang mengancam nyawanya. Drama ini memaparkan perjalanan Blondie mencari identiti, cinta sejati, dan jalan untuk menentukan sama ada dia harus kembali ke dunianya atau kekal mengubah takdir di zaman purba.

programme.title: Nasi Kerabu Mek Bunga

Siti Zubedah lebih di kenali sebagai Mek berketurunan melayu berkawan rapat dengan Bunga Kim Fai berketurunan cina. Bunga dalam bahasa cina iaitu Fai. Mereka berkawan rapat sejak dari kecil lagi.

programme.title: Jangan Pernah Lupakan Aku

programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: UsopWilchaMehghonjangMakhlukMuzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.desc: Swordsman Lee Nan hides in a village to escape from his enemies. There, he witnessed people are desperate for help and the killer buried in his heart finally makes his appearance. (剑客李南躲在村子里逃避敌人。在那里,他亲眼目睹人们急切地寻求帮助,而埋藏在他心底的凶手终于露面。)

programme.title: COLD EYES (寒冷的眼睛)

programme.title: LOVE BARISTA ((爱情咖啡师))

programme.title: LOVE RESET ((爱情重置))

programme.title: MIDNIGHT RUNNERS ((青年警察：午夜跑者))

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo ((澳门街))
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR? programme.title: Mrs. RevengeWhats On Today ((Mrs. Revenge即将上映电影))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness! (善良的心情的杭萨曼塔科患有某种终结性疾病,因为她只是在丈夫谢凯瓦伊乔纳森的暴政下存在.她发现丈夫和她唯一的朋友普恩苏特曼罗西塔·奎克发生了外遇,在争论时,她被推到道路上,并被车车车悲剧地撞击.然而,杭突然醒来,意识到一切似乎只是一个梦.但随着她的梦中的场景逐渐实现,她认为这是一个预见.为了重写命运,杭决心扭转她的梦中的不幸.杭不仅想摆脱那个丑和她的假朋友,而且还试图把两个人一起来,以便苏特曼能够接管她的不幸.她最终在梦中使用自己的梦想,并逐渐发展了幸福感,她和凯瑟琳一起)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. programme.title: Her Railway Trip (她的铁路旅行)
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey. (日本铁路世界千差万别,从风景山谷到海岸线。 每条火车的车窗都像一幅风景绘画,吸引了铁路爱好者。近年来,它也吸引了许多妇女,产生了一个独一无二的叫Tetsuko的绰号叫Tetsuko的火车女郎。这个由即将上台的女演员Ni Jiawen和He Yongsao牵头的节目,通过日本铁路旅行的魅力,让观众走上旅程。它不仅介绍铁路本身,还探索铁路横跨的地道和城市,展示铁路和城镇交织创造的独特景观。不管你是铁路爱好者还是观光者,都喜欢探索新的文化,Tetsukos Lofty山提供了一条浪漫和令人惊讶的铁路旅程。)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate? (许多人可能认为年长者没有性需求,但调查表明,年长者通常因各种原因而没有更多的性活动.社会福利部的临床心理学家林海明解释了世界卫生组织对性行为的定义,并为希望与伴侣重新启动性生活的人提供建议.)

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. (报道关于香港,跨海和国际事务的重要新闻.)

programme.title: Grow Grow Grow With You (与你一起成长成长)
programme.desc: From Hopscotch to Hands Up, TVBs childrens programs have accompanied childrens growth, creating countless wonderful childhood memories. Veteran childrens program hosts Tam Yuk-ying, Lai Chi-shan, and Gai Sai-bo have also grown up alongside you! Each episode will feature a different theme, inviting hosts from different eras to reunite and reminisce about the past. Decades have passed, and the young hosts and participants of yesteryear have all grown up considerably. The hosts have gone out of their way to find these people and relive those memorable moments with everyone. The classic segment Soaring Through the Air holds countless happy memories. The hosts and guest Ali Lee will guide a new generation of children through the fun. (从Hopscotch到“举手”,TVB儿童节目伴随儿童成长,创造了无数美好的童年记忆。老童节目主播Tam Yuk-ying、Lai Chi-shan和盖赛宝也与你们一起成长!每集的主题将不同,邀请不同时代的主持人重新团聚和回忆过去。十年已经过去,过去年的年轻接待者和参与者都长大了很多。东道主已经离开自己的路去寻找这些人,与每个人一起重新体验那些难忘的时刻。经典的空中飞跃段有着无数快乐的回忆。东道主和客人阿里·李将引导新一代儿童度过乐趣。)

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. (香港生活充满活力和多样性,香港生活,香港愉悦呈现了复杂和优雅的生活方式和实在的,高质量的体验.该节目结合了各种主题,探索了每个集中的不同领域,并邀请了来自不同行业的精英分享成功的秘密.)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge. (儿童节目"手上升"鼓励孩子们勇敢地问问题,表达自己,追求自己的目标!子家族成员加入主持人表演短短剧,陪伴所有人享受快乐的时刻.节目还将有各种儿童歌曲,让孩子们一起唱歌,同时学习实用生活知识.)

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue ((过街英雄))
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan. (柳亮在一次交通事故中不幸失去了左耳,在接受移植手术后,他获得了神秘的老鼠权。良星不断制造假消息以为自己谋利。他与正直的女警察宋海燕王普西利亚(Sung Hoi-yan Pricilla Wong)发生冲突,导致他们两人失业。在她叔叔Ming Kwan-ngai KK KK 张的支持下,贺燕成为私人调查员。梁星被迫帮助慧妍探查她的调查活动,因为他利用神秘的力量去探明Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam女神。金发的Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong作为富有的家族继承人,Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau 和她成为了敌人,受到残酷的骚扰。Mi-fun-fun 原谅徐伟,并主动提出帮助他陷入困境。梁星越来越傲慢,因为他用自己的权力来解决案子。与此同时,Hoi-yyan 突然地发现我本人的心力和心力。)

programme.title: Want To De-stress (想摆脱压力)
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health. (许多城市居民都在为生活和职业生涯而努力,没有时间放松,积累的压力会迅速引发健康问题。这个计划邀请各个领域的专业人员,如芳香疗法师、音乐治疗师、彩色治疗师、营养学家和心理学家,使用无障碍的方法,包括案例研究和有趣的测验,以体现五感的和谐与平衡,帮助观众立即释放压力。这个计划还将邀请名人与东道方进行坦率的对话,分享他们应对生活和工作沉重压力的有效方法。这个计划还包括许多有趣的减压提示,以加深观众对减压对健康的重要性的理解。)

programme.title: ChatSAT ((未来警察))
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, Group friend listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program. (基金会将竭尽全力从世界各地收集最流行的最新信息,涵盖从全球事件、医学百科全书、艺术和技术到日常生活以及趋势化在线话题等各个方面,每个星期六与观众分享这些内容。 通过讨论太阳下的一切和谈论最热门话题,团体友人听众可以很容易地跟上全球趋势,跟踪节目。)

programme.title: Miss Hong Kong Pageant 2026 ((香港小姐湘遇记))
programme.desc: Miss Hong Kong Pageant 2026: Hunan Moments follows the top 12 contestants as they travel to Hengyang, Hunan for intensive training and outdoor filming. (2026年香港大明星小姐:湖南时,)

programme.title: Eighth Happiness ((八星报喜))
programme.desc: The three Fang brothers love stories begin with a chance phone malfunction. The eldest brother, Fang Jianhui, meets Wu Fenfang during a visit, but their relationship ends when Wus ex-husband reconciles. The younger brother, Fang Jianlang, though ultimately in love with Tian Hong, continues his philandering ways, later becoming entangled in a love triangle with the beautiful BEAUTY, but ultimately returns to Hongs side. The youngest brother, Fang Jiansheng, meets Yingying, a naive and lively girl, and their romance is warm and sweet. (三方兄弟爱的故事始于偶然的电话故障。长兄方建辉在访问中遇到了吴方方芳,但他们的关系在吴氏前夫和解后结束。 弟弟方建朗虽然最终爱上天红,但继续其游荡的方式,后来陷入了与美丽的BEAUTY的爱情三角中,但最终又回到了洪斯一侧。最年轻的哥哥方建正,遇到了一个天真又活泼的女孩英英明,他们的浪漫温柔又温柔。)

programme.title: News At 18:30 ((重轻参与的播客))
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30. (每天下午6点30分,Jade Channel报道了重要的当地,跨海峡和国际新闻.)

programme.title: News Magazine 2026 Yes, Boss. ((中文 2026 Yes, Boss.))
programme.desc: News Perspective is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments. (新闻展望是一个每周一次的节目,深入报道香港和世界各地的显著新闻报导,重点是对香港居民最为重要的社会问题,并邀请各部门人士、学者和专家讨论和分析根本原因和发展。)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Health Commitment Letter (卫生承诺信)
programme.desc: Health Commitment Letter is a health-focused information program public awareness initiative on TVB Jade. It brings in medical professionals and hosts to educate the public on disease prevention, healthy living habits, and wellness management, encouraging viewers to pledge toward a healthier lifestyle (《健康承诺信》是一项以保健为重点的信息方案,在TVB Jade上开展提高公众认识的活动,它吸引医务专业人员和东道主对公众进行疾病预防、健康生活方式和健康管理教育,鼓励观众承诺建立更健康的生活方式。)

programme.title: Music Money Monster ((唱钱))
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on. (利用声音范围和准确时间的极限,全新的互动音乐游戏节目《音乐金钱怪兽》由Sammy、Eric Kwok和Lee Yin-tung主持。专业的球场分析系统测试参赛者。9平方格代表9个难度级别。连接三条线以通过赛道的参赛者可以选择撤回胜出,继续挑战,甚至尝试最困难的球场。失败的结果是没有奖金!业余版允许单唱参与者竞争10万新元的最高奖。名人版通过与现场参赛者互动,向观众提供赢得奖品和礼物的机会,并派化名人来欢呼。)

programme.title: J Music 2026 (音乐2026年)
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry. (J音乐致力于创建高质量的音乐平台,为歌手提供展示其音乐天赋的机会,同时让音乐迷能够更深入地了解其音乐故事。这个节目邀请流行歌手作为嘉宾,亲自选择其最喜欢的新旧作品,现场演出,并分享其最喜欢的曲目。音乐场面的新面孔也将出现,通过互动交流展示其音乐潜力。此外,每集都密切关注《玉实金图》的最新发展,包括音乐视频和与各种歌手、作曲家和制作者的访谈,他们讨论他们的工作以及音乐行业内的人与活动。)

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again ((中文))
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the King of Ghosts Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of Spirit Connection, with the team closely following live broadcasts, (你并非孤军奋战的归来者!在第二个赛季,节目再次由鬼王梁西浩王(Ghosts Leung Si Ho)和黄耀英、黄志燕(Wong Yiu Ying Ying)和编辑王志燕(Wong Ying Yeuk)和黄智燕(Tong Chi Yan)共同主持,让观众们更加高兴和惊讶。每集都关注不同的超自然主题,由分享幽灵故事并揭露宗教仪式和行业习俗秘密的重量级客人组成。在充满神秘的世界里,节目汇集了来自全球的超自然新闻,而志燕将前往南韩和台湾探索当地超自然现象。与观众的实时互动也是“精神联系”的亮点,与团队密切跟踪实况广播,)

programme.title: News Roundup ((现在不是出轨的问题))
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports. (报道来自香港,台湾海峡及世界各地的重大新闻,以及体育新闻,)

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: New Taiwan Is Online
programme.desc: In a media landscape flooded with misinformation, this current affairs programme cuts through the noise with sharp analysis and investigative reporting. Hosted by Lee Cheng Hao, the show uncovers hidden issues and speaks up for the people, delivering clarity and accountability in every episode.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.
