programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online is a vibrant lifestyle and beauty show featuring the latest in makeup, skincare, and fashion. Each episode shares practical tips and fun challenges that inspire confidence and celebrate personal style.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: This show focuses on the issues that are most important to urban modern women. It combines current events with discussions of lifes major and minor problems and invites various specialists to address various difficulties. Netizens will occasionally attend the show to share their own stories and ask questions of the guests and experts, making the topics more relevant and audience-focused!

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: The show Top Singers aims to spotlight outstanding Taiwanese singers and composers, setting a new standard in the industry. Combining elements of competition, variety, and personal stories, the show welcomes participants of all ages. Its goals include discovering grassroots talent, innovating Taiwanese song performance styles, and involving more local talent in song composition to infuse new life into Taiwanese music.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Every second counts in Show Biz to bring you with the most High Speed star news, exciting live shows and performers interviews.

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: Oversteer
programme.desc: Adapted from a true story, the film follows Feng, a determined young man who defies his father to pursue his dream of becoming an automotive mechanic. Alongside his childhood friend Yun, he embarks on a daring journey that unexpectedly plunges them into the exhilarating world of racing, sparking a passionate coming-of-age adventure.

programme.title: Smashing Frank ((捣破法兰克))
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves Frank, their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game. (四个戴着兔子面具的年轻盗贼把抢劫者从富人身上拉出来。 弗兰克(Frank)自称“弗兰克 ”, 他们的任务不是金钱,而是通过涂鸦和视频视频揭露腐败。 然而,当他们与参与洗钱计划的强大教会串通时,他们的任务就变成了一场致命的游戏。)

programme.title: Ready OR Knot ((不日成婚))
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not? (盖伊和海迪在婚宴上第一次见面以来已经在一起五年了,但婚姻很快就成为了他们关系的挑战.海迪认为婚姻是他们爱的见证,而盖伊认为这是末日.)

programme.title: Triad ((三生花))
programme.desc: This is a story about the Hong Kong Triads. Ting William Chan. Cheung Derek Tsang and Dong Edward Chui are childhood friends who join a Triad together. After joining however, they discover that fame and fortune will ultimately break them apart as only one of them can become the leader of the gang. (这是关于香港三合会的故事。 钟·威廉·陈。 张德里克·赞和东·爱德华·楚伊是童年的朋友,他们一起加入三合会。 但是,在加入后,他们发现名声和财富最终将粉碎他们,因为他们中只有一人能够成为黑帮头目。)

programme.title: Its A Wonderful Life ((好运到))
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all. (香港巨头任达库安照顾了他的四代家庭,然而他的三个儿子都面临着自己的挑战.他的女儿回到法国和她的朋友罗伯托一起学习时,一切都发生了变化.罗伯托为任家带来了一波转型,为所有人带来了新的希望和机会.)

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident ((生きてみたいもう一度 新宿バス放火事件))
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival. (中国移民铁头党在东京和移民同胞一起为生存而奋斗,然后才开始建立新的三合会。 正如他获得合法居留权并决定离开黑社会一样,警察镇压和背叛也迫使他回到一场无情的生存斗争中。)

programme.title: YOLO ((乐活姐妹：怪诞冒险))
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey. (黎英在短短的工作经历之后选择退出社会。 一天,在一系列意外事件之后,她决定重新拥抱生活。 当她遇到拳击教练时,她看到了重新开始的机会,但前面的挑战远远超过她的期望,标志着她的旅程充满活力的开始。)

programme.title: In Broad Daylight ((盲人杀妻记))
programme.desc: Based on a true event of a news investigative unit receiving a tip-off about the abuse of residents in an Elderly and Disabled Care Home. To expose the homes wrongdoings, reporter Kay goes undercover to expose the inhumanity and unveil the cruel truth under broad daylight. (依据一个新闻调查股收到的关于虐待老年人和残疾人照料之家居民的举报的真实事件,为了揭露这些家庭不法行为,记者Kay在光天化日之下秘密揭露了不人道和残酷的真相。)

programme.title: Back to the Past ((寻秦记))
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself. (帮助英正团结中国后,洪小龙在隔离中生活了20年,然而,当一群时空旅行者带着现代武器返回时,夺回秦王位,和平就破灭了。 数十年后被迫重聚,洪小龙和英正必须奋力捍卫秦王,保护历史的命运。)

programme.title: Vital Signs ((生死征兆))
programme.desc: Paramedic Wang partners with Ma after being reassigned to a new station. Initially, Wang disagrees with Mas unconventional methods, but over time, Ma helps him rediscover the true mission of a paramedic - saving every life. (马氏病与马氏病在被重新分配到一个新的站点后,与马氏的半医务人员合作。 起初,王氏不同意马氏非常规方法,但随着时间的推移,马氏帮助他重新发现救护人员的真正使命 — — 拯救每一条生命。)

programme.title: Cold War ((冷战风云录))
programme.desc: A hijacking of a police van occurs when the Police Commissioner is away from Hong Kong. Deputy Commissioner Lee leads a rescue operation code-named Cold War. Fellow Deputy Commissioner Sean moves to take control from Lee as he thinks Lee is emotionally affected by his son being held hostage, but the efforts end up threatening both their reputation. (警方专员离开香港后,便发生劫持警车事件。 李副局长领导了一个代号为冷战的救援行动。 肖恩副局长副局长西恩(Sean)试图控制李(Lee),因为他认为李(Lee)因儿子被扣为人质在情感上受到影响,但他的所作所为最终威胁到他们的声誉。)

programme.title: Home Sweet Home ((情归阿拉巴马))
programme.desc: A school bus accident kills almost everyone on board. The bus driver got injured and partially lost his memory while rescuing one of the boys. To thank the driver, the boys dad, Wang, brings him to live with the family in their basement. However, the driver soon discovers strange behaviours from the Wangs which seem to be related to the accident. (校车事故几乎使船上的所有人都丧生,公共汽车司机在救一个男孩时受伤,部分失忆。谢谢司机,父亲是男孩,王,他带着他和家人住在地下室。然而,司机很快就发现王家的奇怪行为,似乎与事故有关。)

programme.title: Last Song For You ((久别·重逢))
programme.desc: That summer, young Xia and Su bonded over their love of music, wondering how far this love could take them. Years later, musician Su unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journeyher parting gift to reignite his life. (夏天,年轻的Xia和Su为他们的音乐爱而纠缠在一起,想知道这种爱能带他们走多远。 几年后,音乐家Su Suu突然与他的初恋Xia在最黑暗的时间内在医院里团聚。 悲哀的Xia和Su看到自己的内心斗争,最后的旅途礼物是离开苏,重现他的生活。)

programme.title: Moscow Mission ((警察学校7：进军莫斯科))
programme.desc: The story is based on a 1993 true event, the China-Russia Train Robbery where a gang of criminals commits a heist, stealing cash and goods from the cross border train. A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman heads the operation to arrest the criminals, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead (故事的根据是1993年发生的一次真实事件,即中俄火车抢劫,一帮罪犯抢劫一帮罪犯抢劫,从跨境火车上偷盗现金和货物。 中国一名警察伪装成商人,领导逮捕罪犯的行动,但发现了更大的阴谋。)

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places ((最佳拍档之醉街拍档))
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead... (志在父亲被漂亮的骗子Ling杀死后成为新三合会老大。虽然专业枪手Drunken Gun负责帮助Hao Shi报仇,但Ling却被李氏黑帮追捕,她骗了200万美元。在这个过程中,Hao Shi和Drunk Gun无意中逮捕了李氏。)

programme.title: To Live and Die in Mongkok ((旺角監獄))
programme.desc: Fai Nick Cheung, a legendary triad figure, was convicted and sent to prison for slaughtering a bunch of people. 30 years later, with the help of a social worker Chan Lai Wan, Fai release from prison, the city of Mongkok has totally changed and he has almost forgotten his way back home. Disoriented and trapped in the notorious town of vices, Fai must find his way out of a life with a mother suffering from Alzheimers disease Paw Hee Ching, a hooker girlfriend Mo Xiaoqi with her mentally-challenged younger sister Natalie Meng, and a malicious cop Liu Kai Chi hot on his tail. (30年后,在一名社会工作者陈莱万(Chan Lai Wan)的帮助下,Fai Nick 张(一个传奇的三合会人物)因屠杀一群人而被定罪并被送进监狱。 30年后,在一名社会工作者Chan Lai Wan(Fai)的帮助下,蒙哥克市完全改变了,几乎忘记了回家的路。 费伊必须找到办法,摆脱一个患有老年痴呆症的母亲Paw Hee Ching(Paw Hee Ching ), 妓女女友Mo Xiaqi(Mo Xiaoqi)和她心智不全的妹妹Natalie Meng(Natalie Meng)和恶意的警察Lu Kai Chi的尾巴。)

programme.title: The Italian Recipe ((遇见你之后))
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Peng and Mang have nothing in common but spend a magical night in Rome together. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love. (著名的流行偶像彭派去罗马参加一个现实秀,遇到一个梦想成为意大利大厨的普通女孩曼格(Mang ) 。 彭曼除了在罗马共度一个神奇的夜晚之外,没有什么共同之处。 随着两人开始相爱,他们的生活开始发生变化。)

programme.title: The Myth ((西西弗斯的神话))
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qins celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny. (考古学家杰克在神秘梦的指引下发现,他过去曾是孟易义将军,与玉洙公主有着长达一千年的悲剧性爱。 当他们重新聚首于秦氏天皇宫时,一位无情的大亨在寻找永生的秘密。 夺回他过去的力量,杰克面临着命运的最后一场战斗。)

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man ((百变星君))
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love. (歌手是一个在国外留学的富人,但被宠坏了,他永远无法专心于学习,而是花时间与女孩调情。 有一天,当他和情妇西尔维娅勾搭在一起时,歌手被黑帮吹了起来。 这个傲慢的恶作剧者被复活了,成了一个拥有独特技能、真正工作和新的真爱的无法打败的半机械人。)

programme.title: We are Family (我们是家庭)
programme.desc: Struggling as an extra, Chi Kwong joins a rent-a-family company run by Carlos and aspiring actress Catherine, and rent themselves out as make-believe relatives. As they surrogate different families, they unravel the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way. (作为一个额外的家庭成员,奇加入卡洛斯和望女演员凯瑟琳的租公司,并租自己作为假设的亲戚.)

programme.title: The Medallion ((飞龙再生))
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival. (香港侦探Eddie在拯救一个神话般的儿童时,在国际搜寻人口贩运集团的过程中死亡。 被神圣的Cadellion所恢复,他获得了非凡的治疗力量。 然而,当他的无情的神经元也夺取了它的权力时,Eddie必须冲进一个险恶的城堡,为生存进行残酷的斗争。)

programme.title: Peg O My Heart ((赎梦))
programme.desc: Psychiatrist Dr. Man begins treating night-shift taxi driver Choi, who is afraid to sleep and can no longer distinguish dreams from reality. During therapy, Dr. Man becomes haunted by his own disturbing and perplexing dreams. Are these night terrors the result of repressed memories, or the price of uncovering the ghosts hidden in Chois past? (曼博士开始治疗夜间轮班出租车司机崔博士,他害怕睡觉,无法再将梦想与现实区分开来。 在治疗期间,曼博士被自己令人不安的、令人困惑的梦所困扰。 这些夜惊是被压抑的记忆所造成,还是被揭开Chois过去所隐藏的幽灵的代价?)

programme.title: Cold War 2 ((寒战2))
programme.desc: Sean Lau is now the Police Commissioner after the successful rescue operation Cold War. However, the culprits from the past not only dodged justice but even escalated their actions and kidnapped Laus wife. He breaks every protocol to get her back, which puts him under investigation. (刘肖恩在冷战救援行动成功后现在担任警务专员。 然而,过去的罪犯不仅逃避了司法制裁,甚至升级了他们的行动,绑架了刘易斯的妻子。 他打破了所有协议,将她送回去,这让他受到调查。)

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life ((浅浅岁月))
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime. (桑比娜对安德鲁的深厚爱情在他的恋爱破坏了他们的婚姻后,导致她的心碎.多年后,当安德鲁被诊断患有癌症时,桑比娜选择回来照顾她的前丈夫,尽管过去的痛苦.随着旧情绪的复苏,她仍然相信真正的爱情只会在一生中出现一次.)

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot ((少林海燈大師))
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time. (少林少林教主派和尚奇三去向吴当神父学习特别的武术,他在清和明阵营的战斗中被蒙骗,必须同时召集门徒重建被烧焦的少林寺庙。)

programme.title: Heads For Sale ((女侠卖人头))
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge. (胡是一位正直勇敢的剑士,她会为她爱的罗罗做任何事情.当罗罗被腐败警察送入监狱时,她开始释放他,并毫不犹地砍下两名保卫人的头部.在这个过程中,她也遇到了父亲的老敌人,他回来寻求报复.)

programme.title: The Golden Knight ((牙狼))
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth (玉飞霞女英雄被控偷窃武术秘密书,为证明她无罪,她假扮成男子汉,进入少林寺了解真相)

programme.title: Double Bliss ((双喜临门))
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple. (东中和朱计划结婚,但他们的家族是终身竞争对手,不赞成。 他们决定假自杀,最终让父母双方解决分歧并批准婚姻。 同时,一家唱片公司宣布他们将发行东斯歌曲,为夫妇带来双欢。)

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox (狐的传说)
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the mens help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father. (一位年轻人(Chin)认为他是一个孤儿,直到他遇见了三个人,并向他们学习到他的父亲是一位伟大的剑客,他的父亲在试图消除关于不法行为的谣言并将丢失的剑还给其合法主人时被杀害了。 Chin寻找男人帮助报复他父亲的不法死亡。)

programme.title: Madam White Snake ((新白蛇传))
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split... (琳达林戴是完美的作为帕克苏,一个惊人的蛇女神,她以女性的形式,以至于她可以品尝人类生活的快乐!帕克诱惑年轻学者,Hsu Hsien当她承认他作为她的救主在另一个生命1000年前.)

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo ((通天小子红枪客))
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Baos chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer? (青宝东亲眼目睹了恶毒的恶棍残酷杀害他的功夫大师。凶手在Baos的胸口发现一个大老鹰纹身。)

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City ((解密紫禁城))
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor. (法官发现李新生儿在出生时被换换,女皇20年前驱逐她出宫殿.他让女士承认与女皇的阴谋.女皇因她的行为被定罪,李女士最终与她现在的儿子重聚.)

programme.title: The Mighty One ((后院活宝))
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors... (龙龙寻找五卷著名的功夫手册,以获得不可战胜力。当他相信武术师傅拥有这本书时,他杀死他和他的女儿,但留下一个弟弟妹妹。 几年后,龙龙输了两卷,又开始了另一次血腥狩猎,但每次尝试都被两个神秘的战士打断...)

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1977 (红厅的梦想)
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple. (根据同名的中国经典小说,著名的贾家族的儿子尤深深爱上了他的表弟戴尤.然而,他的母亲不赞成他们的关系,并计划安排尤嫁给另一个富裕的女孩,导致完美的夫妇的悲惨结局.)

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters (主人的挑战)
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his fathers martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hungs passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lus disciple. (黄飞鸿必须证明自己值得卢师傅(也是他父亲的武术老师)的教导。 尽管在一次比赛中被击败,但黄飞鸿对功夫的热情终于让卢一举,让他成为卢二世的徒弟。)

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses ((天使出更))
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series. (在圣莫兰特医院,一位热情而可爱的管理者必须处理贪婪的实习生、学生护士、一位精神错乱的外科医生、一位解剖恶魔、一位批评专员并定期严重疏忽的人。 这出喜剧是基于英国演唱会的巨大成功! 电影系列。)

programme.title: The Flag of Iron ((铁旗门))
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with The Five Venoms actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys from the villainous clan and its so filled with dont-blink-or-you-will-miss-something gags, you will need to watch it over and over again so you can see the things you missed. (当超级导演张哲发现五毒演员的新才华和鲜血时, 大部分都是在中国高清歌剧中受训的, 并且精通奇异武术武器, 这为他在电影中使用奇异武器创造了新的火花。 《铁旗》是他导演的20部电影之一, 其中一部是这5个家伙制作的彻底挥舞和体力耗尽的动作。 你们有正派部落的好人, 而不是恶派部落的坏人, 里面充满了多管闲事的杂耍, 你们需要一遍又一遍地看一遍, 才能看到你们错过的东西。)

programme.title: The Jade Raksha ((玉罗刹))
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind (一位叫杰德·拉卡沙的可怕的剑剑女出现在武术世界中,开始杀害姓燕的人。一位剑士知道她是谁,问她为什么。显然,18年前,一个燕子杀了她的家人,她只有报复心智。)

programme.title: River of Tears (眼的河)
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husbands death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living... (退休歌手和丈夫和儿子生活得很快乐.悲剧发生在她过去的一个男人回来追捕她时.在随后的斗争中,为了摆脱她的手,她的丈夫在车祸中死亡.被她的岳父指责为丈夫的死亡,被赶出房子,回到歌唱中以谋生.)

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again ((乌龙济公))
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins. (活佛吉骨和不朽的Lu Dong Bin沉浸在凡人世界中,数名妇女的命运引发了一场争斗。 当这两个神灵在三次奇特的竞赛中展示其力量时,一系列可笑的不幸事件发生了。 在浪漫纠缠中,不朽者和人类之间开始了一场史诗般的战斗。)

programme.title: Fast Fingers ((梁上君子))
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bills nieces! (比尔叔叔从监狱获释后,回来与过去的伙伴们一起发财。 他们继续利用那些不知情的公众,但受到正直的警察局长的密切监视,他恰好是比尔斯叔叔侄女之一的男朋友!)

programme.title: The Last Tempest ((瀛台泣血))
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power. (多华王后继此事件之后,广州皇帝和多瓦赫王后仍继续传说光苏和西西皇后的故事。 尽管广州皇帝登上皇宫,但西西始终存在的势力掩盖了他有效统治的能力。 当他改革帝国体制的尝试被多瓦高太后挫败时,广州试图扼制她的权力。)

programme.title: Come Drink with Me ((大醉侠))
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman Golden Swallow is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar Drunken Cat who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kongs entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards. (神秘剑术女皇金燕女的弟弟被绑架了。她与一位乞丐德伦肯·卡特(Drunken Cat)联手,他擅长武术,将兄弟从腐败的修道院中解放出来。 这部电影被选为香港第39届学院奖最佳外语电影参赛者。)

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost ((鬼屋丽人))
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale... (爱是超越坟墓的, 年轻学者和他的美丽的情人 永远被他卑鄙的叔叔和朋友撕裂...)

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu ((南拳蔡李佛))
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wongs disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples. (著名的功夫大师黄飞鸿在广东教武术。 一个恶毒的黑帮阴谋要伤害黄徒门徒,陷害他抢劫和谋杀。 王王必须对抗罪犯以证明他无罪并报复门徒。)

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess ((万花迎春))
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance. (贝蒂在一个舞蹈团中担任主角舞蹈家,并申请成为一位富有的女孩贝蒂的司机.当传言说他是她的情人时,贝蒂生气,并作为一名报道员来调查谣言.他们在这个过程中恋爱,经过许多测试后,他们最终用舞蹈封闭了他们的爱情.)

programme.title: Raw Courage ((虎胆))
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies (在明皇被推翻,他的幼子被交给黑龙会照顾后,一个叛国武术部族攻击社会,迫使一对经验不足的剑士和剑士妇带着婴儿逃离。)

programme.title: Family Light Affair ((城市之光))
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as City Lights, is the directorwriters warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles. (Alfred 张金庭带着这种对中大陆农民带家人来香港时所引发的不同文化冲突,回到了屏幕上。 家庭光美(中文名译为城市灯)是80年代初期的街头生活热心的导演回忆录,其特色是流行音乐和武艺明星的歌舞剧,他们扮演着光辉的角色。)

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin ((少林与武当))
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun (在清朝中,少林氏族想推翻清清,恢复明朝,而武当族则得到清政府的支持。 两大知名氏族最终相互对立,一系列恶战刚刚开始。)

programme.title: The Crimson Palm ((血手印))
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiance, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence? (可怜的林文学家与富家女订婚,但她父亲因其家庭背景而看不起他。在出国参加皇室考试之前,林文探亲,只为了发现一个死在血中的女佣。 当现场发现他的血迹时,他成了主要嫌疑犯。 宝法官能证明他无罪吗?)

programme.title: Pattathu Yaanai
programme.desc: Saravanan and his friends come to Trichy to set up a new restaurant business. However, their plans get interrupted when he gets an order from a local gangster but falls for his girlfriend, Aishwarya.

programme.title: Theeni
programme.desc: Dev, an overweight but genius chef, falls in love with his charming colleague, Tara. However, their love story takes a turn when Maya, a happy-go-lucky woman, enters their lives.

programme.title: Manjapai
programme.desc: An aged villager comes to the city and sets people right.

programme.title: Savarakathi
programme.desc: A barber has a bad encounter with a gangster on the road and this results in him running all over the city to save himself.

programme.title: Nadigaiyar Thilagam
programme.desc: Savitri, the most admired actress from South Indian cinema, goes through various tragic incidents in her personal life. Unable to cope with depression, she eventually becomes an alcoholic.

programme.title: Mishan Impossible
programme.desc: The adventures of three young boys, who want to capture Indias most-wanted fugitive Dawood Ibrahim.

programme.title: Kaari
programme.desc: A powerful tycoon controls a helpless village-until a bold jockey arrives. With grit and heart, he races not just horses, but injustice, bringing hope and courage to the people.

programme.title: Kavan
programme.desc: A TV journalist goes against the orders of his corrupt and dishonest boss and helps a group of youngsters in their fight against a pesticide factory.

programme.desc: A young man, known for helping couples elope, is forced by a gangster to kidnap a politicians daughter after he stops the wedding of a girl who didnt want to marry him.

programme.title: Sarkarin Elam
programme.desc: A finance agent is conned by his love interest and travels to India to get his money back from her influential father, who is a Member of Parliament and industrialist.

programme.title: Diya
programme.desc: After her abortion, a womans life gets wild when she starts seeing her grown fetus, who appears to guide her through unexpected emotions and challenges.

programme.desc: Gangster Soori, known as Captain, aids people in need. Meeting Nisha brings transformative love. Will his past hinder a new beginning?

programme.desc: Gandhis life spirals when he clashes with gangster Dilli Babu while dealing with Pseudobulbar.

programme.title: Madha Yaanai Koottam
programme.desc: Prithivi kill his uncles son unfortunately. So his uncle and other family members take revenge on him.

programme.title: Nerkonda Paarvai
programme.desc: A retired veteran lawyer returns to defend three women falsely accused in a criminal case, facing powerful enemies and patriarchal biases in court.

programme.title: Krack
programme.desc: When 3 notorious criminals lock horns with a hot-tempered police officer, Potharaju Shankar, little do they know that they will end up behind bars.

programme.desc: Paddy McGuinness and Cherry Healey visit a factory producing half a million sausage rolls a day. (帕迪麦金尼斯和樱桃希利 参观一家工厂 每天生产50万卷香肠)

programme.title: 13 Hours To Survive
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))
programme.desc: Witness veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb save an elephant calf caught in a poachers snare, racing time to treat the wound. Back at the base, an orphaned baby baboon meets his new family. A monitor lizard and duiker are returned to freedom in the wild. (Amanda Salb 医生拯救了一只被偷猎者捕捉的大象小牛,比赛时间是治疗伤口的时间。在基地,一只孤儿幼崽在基地遇到了他的新家人。一只监测蜥蜴和杜克在野外重获自由。)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))
programme.desc: Amanda puts a radio collar on one of the first cheetah cubs born in Malawi in twenty years and the team struggles to give a 4-meter python a physical. See a group of tourists deliver a rambunctious baby monkey they rescued from the pet trade. (阿曼达在20年来出生于马拉维的第一只猎豹幼崽之一上贴了无线电项圈,团队竭力要给一只4米长的象牙做体能。 看到一群游客运送一只从宠物行业救出来的笨拙的幼猴。)

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running With The Pack (野狗:与群众一起跑)
programme.desc: Dodge a leopard with the Manzi dogs while they treat themselves to a stolen feast. No such luck for the Kakuli pack on the hunt, as theyre foiled by a brave puku antelope. Find the stork pack, and retreat from charging elephants with Jules and Simon. (与曼齐犬一起躲藏一只豹子,而他们却把自己当作一个被偷的宴会。 猎杀的卡库利包没有那么幸运,因为它们被勇敢的马库蚂蚁打败了。 找到鹿包,并不再用朱尔斯和西蒙来指控象。)

programme.title: Planet Weird ((星際姊妹))
programme.desc: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood. (进入在地球上游荡的最凶恶的帮派,看看野外真正的暴徒长什么样。 追寻一群掠夺性的蝗虫,看着椰子章鱼伏击下一个食物,见到一群尝到血味的狐狸。)

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australias Ocean Wonder ((宁格鲁：澳大利亚的海洋奇观))
programme.desc: Learn how Ningaloos conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change. (学习宁格洛斯保护奇迹如何激励人类将地球从气候破坏的边缘拉回。 参观废弃的捕鲸站和其他废墟,这些废墟表明我们拥有工具,如果我们能找到改变的意志的话。)

programme.title: Turtle Beach ((龟滩沥血))
programme.desc: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs. (当地人称之为" arribada",即到达.)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer. (桑比亚斯·卢昂瓦谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人的家园,但真正使它特别的是它的鸟类。这里有400多个不同的物种,每个物种都完全适合利用每一个机会。)

programme.title: Into The Wild Colombia ((进入野外：哥伦比亚))
programme.desc: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate. (莫娜,一个女棉花马林,独自一人在热带森林的家里. 她离开了她的生儿家庭的安全,)

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running With The Pack (野狗:与群众一起跑)
programme.desc: Film a wild dog hunt with Julz as he catches up with the Manzi pack at a kill, and watch for leopards and hyenas as the Kakuli pack takes great risks while waiting for the rains to come. Go on an epic hunt with a returning male of the Stork Colony. (与朱尔兹一起拍摄野狗猎杀,当他赶上曼兹的猎物,看着豹子和土狼,Kakuli的猎物在等待雨水来临时冒很大风险。 与一位返回的斯图尔克殖民地男性一起进行史诗般的猎杀。)

programme.title: Coastal Africa ((非洲沿海))
programme.desc: This is the story of the Golden Forest, the vast expanses of kelp that lines Africas southwestern shore. Fed by an upwelling of nutrients from deep in the Atlantic, the kelp forest nurtures four distinct worlds. (这是金森林的故事,金森林是非洲西南海岸的宽广海藻。 海藻森林通过大西洋深处的营养物增加而形成,培育了四个截然不同的世界。)

programme.title: Animals At Play ((动物玩耍))
programme.desc: Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants. (探索动物玩耍的方式, 包括泰国年轻长袍, 练习从树枝上掉下来,)

programme.title: Animals At Play ((动物玩耍))
programme.desc: Young hyenas compete in tug of war, mischievous parrots play at picking apart tourists cars, and Atlantic spotted dolphins enjoy sophisticated social games amid seaweedall following specific rules that hone social bonds. (年轻的土狼在战争中竞争, 恶作剧的鹦鹉玩弄驱散游客的汽车, 大西洋斑点海豚在海藻中享受复杂的社会游戏, 遵守特殊规则,)

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: Follow penguins, iguanas, tortoises, frogs and tamarins from Mexico to Peru, and as far west as the Galapagos Islands, as they live out their daily dramas, affected by the suns heat, looming predators and hazardous weather conditions. (企鹅、蜥蜴、乌龟、青蛙和马林从墨西哥到秘鲁,远至西边的加拉帕戈斯群岛,因为它们每日都生活在受太阳炎热、食肉动物逼近和危险气候条件影响的戏剧中。)

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: See how creatures from the Tibetan plateau, to the lush rainforests of Thailand, to Vietnams twisted mangroves, survive four extra hours of daylight once a year, searching for food, fighting for dominance and raising their families. (从西藏高原到泰国的雨林, 到越南扭曲的红树林, 每年多活四个小时的日光, 寻找食物,)

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: See how one animal familys tragedy is anothers holiday dinner as New Zealands mainland and island creatures, including penguins, flightless birds, sea lions, and sharks, battle to feed and protect their young in this marine environment. (看看一个动物家庭悲剧是如何成为另一个假日晚餐, 新西兰大陆和岛屿生物, 包括企鹅、无飞行鸟类、海狮和鲨鱼,)

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: Find out which creatures survive and whose luck will run out as animal mothers and moms-to-be struggle with sweltering temperatures, lurking predators, mating season, and drought on a day that proves to be no holiday. (找出哪些生物存活下来 以及他们的运气会随着 动物母亲和即将成为母亲的 与严寒的温度斗争 潜伏的掠食动物 交配季节和干旱而消失)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss, and gain friends, as they discover what it means to be part of the Woodland Troop. (在这片小片林地里,两只年轻的猴子面对着他们一生中最艰难的时刻。当他们在世界上找到自己的位置的时候,他们必须学会谁是盟友,谁是敌人。应当信赖谁,应当避开谁。他们将遭受损失,应当获得朋友,因为他们知道加入伍德兰部队意味着什么。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators. (赞比亚的野生动物是生活难以生存的地方. 在这里,许多动物必须团结起来,帮助保护领土,保护后代,寻找食物和战胜掠食者.)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered... (在卢安加瓦谷每天都会看到一个尸体,每个尸体都包含了导致他们死亡的故事. 在萨法里,我们调查了被发现的三具尸体的死因.)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place offers something unique to the wildlife that chooses to live there. (赞比亚拥有三个非常特殊和不同的非洲沙漠。 低、热、热的Luangwa河谷、高、干枯的Liuwa平原和凉爽、湿润的Kasanka国家公园。 每一个地方都为选择在那里生活的野生动物提供了独特的地方。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer. (桑比亚斯·卢昂瓦谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人的家园,但真正使它特别的是它的鸟类。这里有400多个不同的物种,每个物种都完全适合利用每一个机会。)

programme.title: Evolution Earth ((地球演化實錄))
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planet. (旅行到地球尽头,那里正在实时发生一场戏剧。 迎接动物,从小蝴蝶到大型座头鲸,它们充当哨兵,调整它们的行为,帮助我们解开变化中的地球的谜团。)

programme.title: Evolution Earth ((地球演化實錄))
programme.desc: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galpagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems. (找出为什么岛屿会像小型地球,在你眼前发生进化。 从加尔帕戈斯到南极洲的旅程,看看海狮、鳍、板球、猴子和其他野生动物如何为气候问题找到出乎意料的解决办法。)

programme.title: Evolution Earth ((地球演化實錄))
programme.desc: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller. (从撒哈拉到外背,从撒哈拉到外背,动物教我们如何在暖气世界生存。 栖身于黑猩猩洞穴中,看到骆驼喝盐水,聆听斑马雀雀的歌唱,让小鸡更小。)

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)

programme.title: Big Cat Country ((狮子王国))
programme.desc: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomads brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. programme.title: Big Cat Country ((狮子王国))

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: 杏林在線
programme.desc: 免疫力是維持身體健康的重要防線，不過長期承受壓力，有機會令免疫系統失調，身體自身攻擊器官和細胞致病今集杏林在線訪問了兩位自體免疫疾病的患者，分享確診的心路歷程，以及精神壓力如何影響他們的病情免疫系統就像保安，當細菌病毒入侵身體，它會幫助身體作抵抗，而免疫系統失調會引伸很多疾病，免疫及過敏科專科醫生說，工作壓力大，或者休息不足也是成因港大醫學院臨床醫學學院內科學系名譽臨床助理教授楊韻妍：其實有九成的病人，也沒有家族病史，一般來說病徵也不明顯，有些人可能覺得疲倦，整個身體疼痛或者皮膚出疹，純粹可能是低燒不退但本身這些患者可能會覺得純粹是傷風感冒，或者工作繁忙覺得疲倦，但如果這些病徵是持續性或者經常也會發生，有些循環性的情況，我們也要警惕精神科醫生說情緒和身體是一體，長期承受壓力，又沒有及時休息是大忌中大醫學院精神科榮譽臨床助理教授曹雲萊：很多研究指抑鬱症的患者，患上一些的代謝疾病或者心血管疾病，比起一般人也高出兩至三成亦有一些倒過來，自體免疫系統疾病的病人，器官或細胞自我攻擊，亦比一般人患上情緒病的機會率高出兩至三成

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.
